claims.claim: list machine accepts --vol_size, --vol_price, and --end_date; zero disables the volume offer.
claims.displayedWording:
You can publish GPU and volume offers together:

bash
vastai list machine <machine-id> \
  --vol_size <capacity-gb> \
  --vol_price <usd-per-gb-month> \
  --end_date <date>


Set --vol_size 0 when you do not want the machine listing to include a volume offer. Pass an explicit size and price so the advertised capacity is intentional.
